definitions.explanation: The digestive organ consisting of the small and large intestines. Used in medical, health, and everyday contexts.

⟦ヨーグルト→ヨーグルト：11133_yooguruto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。

notes:
The general term for intestines. Appears in many medical and health-related compounds. Gut health ({腸活|ちょうかつ}) has become a popular wellness topic in Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{大腸|だいちょう}→大腸：27899_daichou⟧ — large intestine, colon
- {小腸|しょうちょう} — small intestine
- {腸内|ちょうない} — intestinal, inside the gut
- {腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう} — gut environment/flora
- {腸炎|ちょうえん} — enteritis, intestinal inflammation
- {盲腸|もうちょう} — appendix; appendicitis (colloquial)
- {腸活|ちょうかつ} — gut health activities
- ⟦{胃腸|いちょう}→胃腸：15503_ichou⟧ — stomach and intestines, gastrointestinal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腸|ちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧ — intestinal condition
- {腸|ちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ — to regulate the intestines
- {腸|ちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ — to have a weak stomach/gut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ — stomach (upper digestive organ)
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ — belly, abdomen (more colloquial for the whole area)
- はらわた — guts, entrails (more visceral/literary)
